definition: of the usual middle size or amount
description: At an autumn pumpkin fair on grass with hay bales and a line of fabric bunting, a middle-sized orange pumpkin drops onto a hay bale in a puff of dust and lands next to a giant pumpkin, while a tiny pumpkin sits on the ground to the left. A young woman with a ponytail, in a rust jumper and denim skirt, shrugs with both palms up and laughs, then bends down towards the pumpkins. A young man in a navy T-shirt walks past behind with a wooden wheelbarrow, and a green cart full of gourds stands under a big oak tree.

de.answer: Sie zuckt mit den Schultern und lacht.
